text:
Type: white bell pendant lamp
Use: general light over a dining table, kitchen island or desk; dining room, kitchen, home office, hallway
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: white matte plastic shade, white fabric cord, white ceiling cup
Colors: white
Shape: bell-shaped shade with a narrow neck that flares to a wide open rim, hangs on a thin cord from a domed ceiling cup, simple smooth outline, medium size, light visual weight
Feel: clean, bright, simple, friendly
Goes with: light wood tables, white walls, black chairs; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern dining rooms and kitchens

product.name: MELODI
product.description: Gives a directed light; good for lighting up for example dining tables or bar tops.
